text:
Carla M: quick sync — posting this week's regional GPU runway + a few asks. please skim + react.

Carla M: high-level: baseline demand up ~20% this week due to marketing push. forecasted GPU-hours next 7d by region below. need decisions on where to lean into spot vs reserved.

infra-bot: current snapshot (auto):
```
US-E: available 7,200 GPU-hours
EU-W: available 3,100 GPU-hours (effective capacity ~2,700 after NIC drops)
APAC: available 900 GPU-hours
Projected demand (7d): US-E 5,800, EU-W 3,600, APAC 1,100
```

Ben H: FYI — EU-W had NIC flaps this morning, caused ~12% usable capacity loss for ~45m. ops ticket: https://redwood.ops/tickets/4821

Alice R: suggestion: shift non-urgent batch jobs from EU-W -> US-E for 48-72h. US-E has headroom and cheaper spot pools.

Daniel K: back-of-envelope: moving 1.5k GPU-hours/week to US-E saves ~ $12k/week (spot), adds ~ $900/week egress. net still ~$11k savings.

Eve S: Dedicated pool headroom: US-E dedicated has ~600 GPUs idle (can absorb steady jobs but not big spike). APAC is tight because of campus training next Tue.

Carla M: options for EOD decision:
- option A: shift batches to US-E for 72h (low risk, some egress cost)
- option B: buy short-term spot capacity in EU-W (keeps locality but market is tight)
- option C: throttle non-prod / postpone runs (lowest cost, higher risk to schedules)

Ben H: I've added temporary throttles on non-prod traffic in EU-W and pinned the NIC driver patch to canary. will update if stability improves.

ops-sre: routing policy snippet if we go auto-fallback: 
```json
{"route": "region_preference", "fallback": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"], "conditions": {"latency_ms": 200, "capacity_pct": 70}}
```
(ops-sre will roll this as a 5% canary)

infra-bot: updated forecast after throttles: EU-W effective demand 3,200 -> short by ~500 GPU-hours. Suggested temporary shift: 600 GPU-hours/day for 3 days.

Alice R: endorsing option A. I'll open the job-slice rollout and update the scheduler tags.

Daniel K: opened PR 8792 to move scheduler tags + added billing alarm (threshold 10k USD daily).

Carla M: decision: proceed with option A for 72h. Alice and Daniel to coordinate. Ben keep NIC patch on canary. Ops-sre monitor the routing canary.

Alice R: will start migration in 30m. posting migration plan in #eng-oncall.

Eve S: note: APAC training window at Tue 09:00-18:00 local — avoid pulling APAC capacity.

Carla M: thanks. reconvene Fri 16:00 for runway check and numbers. if anything critical before then ping me.

Ben H: +1
Alice R: +1
ops-sre: watching :eyes:
infra-bot: scheduled follow-up: 1870016000 (automated runway summary)
